title: trackerAskOptions
responsibility: Validates and decodes tracker ask options, confirmation requirements, and selected answers.

inputs.name: trackerAskOptionFromWord.word
inputs.description: CLI word containing the option label and, optionally, its effect after an equals sign.

inputs.name: normalizeTrackerAskOptions.value
inputs.description: List or serialized list of candidate options. Empty input clears the options.

inputs.name: trackerAskOptions.stored
inputs.description: Stored JSON text for the available answer options.

inputs.name: normalizeTrackerAskConfirm.value
inputs.description: Confirmation kind supplied with an ask. Empty input and none clear the requirement.

inputs.name: chosenTrackerAskOption.stored
inputs.description: Stored JSON options against which the selection is resolved.

inputs.name: chosenTrackerAskOption.choice
inputs.description: Option number in the original order, starting at one.

outputs.name: trackerAskConfirmKinds
outputs.description: Confirmation kinds that require an explicit user confirmation.

outputs.name: trackerAskOptionFromWord
outputs.description: Parsed label and effect with surrounding whitespace removed.

outputs.name: normalizeTrackerAskOptions
outputs.description: Validated, serialized options or null when the options are cleared.

outputs.name: trackerAskOptions
outputs.description: Decoded option list, or an empty list for absent or unreadable text.

outputs.name: normalizeTrackerAskConfirm
outputs.description: Accepted confirmation kind or null when the requirement is cleared.

outputs.name: chosenTrackerAskOption
outputs.description: Selected option and its zero-based position in the stored list.

outputs.name: trackerAskNormalizers
outputs.description: Normalizers for the options, confirmation kind, and chosen option fields.

inputs.description: CLI word containing the option label and, optionally, its effect after an equals sign.

inputs.description: Confirmation kind supplied with an ask. Empty input and none clear the requirement.

outputs.name: normalizeTrackerAskConfirm
outputs.description: Accepted confirmation kind or null when the requirement is cleared.
